qs.s: Ensemble, nous ___ le comité d'approuver le nouveau règlement.
qs.en: Together, we will convince the committee to approve the new regulation.

qs.s: Si les militants avaient plus de ressources, ils ___ l'opinion publique plus rapidement.

qs.en: I want her to convince her parents to let her choose her studies.

qs.en: The lawyer managed to convince the jury of his client's innocence.

qs.en: These facts are enough to make even the most sceptical believe in the reality of climate change.

qs.en: The scientific demonstration finally made all the panel members believe.
